natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates onboarding simplification durably improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Promotional pricing may address the competitor threat but has known renewal-risk uncertainty, so it should not displace the more sustainable activation lever without verifying its guardrails.
